title: Implement validated preset timer configuration and presentation
verify: Record honest pre-implementation RED for each FT-005 AC before changing production behavior; preserve any already-green Foundation timer arithmetic or persistence condition without an unnecessary change.

Run deterministic host checks for exactly three independently persisted preset definitions, defaults of 3m/10m/30m, hours 0–99, minutes 0–59, seconds 0–59, positive-total validation, last-valid-value preservation and automatic reload from the owner store.

Run deterministic label/color checks proving the highest non-zero unit with floor rounding and the accepted orange, pink and purple neon outlines; prove that the selected/active presentation is available through the existing Timer & Alert read path.

Exercise configuration while a timer snapshot exists and prove that preset configuration does not create a second active timer; full start, cancellation, recovery and overdue behavior remains owned by FT-006/FT-007.

Inspect Settings & Location ownership and the existing Main Display → Settings & Location, Timer & Alert → Settings & Location and Main Display → Timer & Alert edges against the Boundary Map and Capability Interfaces; no private-store, direct-neighbor or composition-root business bypass is permitted.

Use isolated in-memory and resettable local-store state for mandatory host persistence checks. Apply target-device evidence only if host checks cannot establish a concrete FT-005 visual result; it is deferred and non-blocking, so record DEFERRED plus residual risk when unavailable and never claim runtime PASS without a target. This planning task creates no runtime evidence or live credentials.

Scheduler closure: /verify VERDICT: PASS and /red-verify SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass on fresh attempt-3 verification; 32/32 host tests and clean build pass, invalid-input last-valid UI restoration confirmed, target evidence remains DEFERRED/non-blocking with no runtime PASS claim. Evidence: .tasks/TASK-007-T3-FT-005-W6/TASK-007-T3-FT-005-W6-S-VERIFY-final-report-docs-01.md and .tasks/TASK-007-T3-FT-005-W6/TASK-007-T3-FT-005-W6-S-RED-VERIFY-final-report-docs-01.md.
evidence_required: [FT-005-AC-001; REQ-011] Expected RED: the Foundation Settings surface has no three-preset configuration projection and the current timer path accepts a direct duration rather than independently configured presets. GREEN: exactly three independently stored presets are exposed, configuration never creates a parallel active timer, and the existing Timer & Alert owner remains the sole active-timer authority. Compare count, independence and active-state cardinality; artifact is the deterministic settings/timer integration result.

[FT-005-AC-002; REQ-011] Expected RED: the Foundation Settings capability has no timer-duration field validation or last-valid-value rule. GREEN: hours 0–99, minutes 0–59 and seconds 0–59 are accepted only when total duration is positive; zero or out-of-range input is rejected, the prior valid value remains available, and valid changes reload after persistence. Compare each boundary and failure case; artifact is the isolated host validation/persistence result.

[FT-005-AC-003; REQ-011] Expected RED: the Foundation display has no preset label formatter or accepted defaults. GREEN: defaults are 3m, 10m and 30m, and each label exposes only the highest non-zero unit with floor rounding. Compare mixed-unit examples and defaults against the accepted rule; artifact is the deterministic label result.

[FT-005-AC-004; REQ-011] Expected RED: the Foundation display has no accepted preset color or selected/active presentation projection. GREEN: the three buttons expose orange, pink and purple neon outlines and the selected/active state is available to the countdown consumer through the existing contracts. Compare color/state tokens and the consumer projection; artifact is the host presentation/integration result, with scoped device observation only if raster behavior cannot be established host-side.
purpose: Turn the Foundation settings/timer seams into the accepted FT-005 preset configuration outcome while preserving Settings & Location as the validation and persistence owner, Timer & Alert as the active-timer owner, and Main Display as the presentation owner.
success_outcome: A clean build and deterministic evidence prove three independently configurable presets with accepted defaults, ranges, positive-total validation, last-valid-value preservation, floor-rounded labels, fixed orange/pink/purple outlines and a selected/active projection consumable by countdown without creating a second active timer or changing FT-006/FT-007 lifecycle behavior.
anti_goals: Do not implement short-tap countdown start, countdown arithmetic, protected cancellation, temporary interruption recovery or overdue dismissal from FT-006.
Do not implement overdue fullscreen rendering, audio selection/ramp/cap or silent/DND behavior from FT-007/FT-009.
Do not implement API-key, country/city catalog, location refresh, sound-volume or glass-intensity settings from FT-008/FT-009; timer-duration fields are the only Settings surface in this task.
Do not add a new module, dependency, event/message boundary, backend/cloud/accounts, Google Services, reboot recovery or product control.

forbidden_scope: FT-001 through FT-004 product behavior beyond their approved dependency chain
FT-006 through FT-009 product behavior and state ownership
direct reads or writes of private Weather Context, Timer & Alert or Settings & Location storage outside the owning contract
business orchestration in MainActivity, generic utilities or the composition root
backend, cloud sync, accounts, Google Services and reboot recovery
live API keys or secret-bearing source, logs, screenshots, fixtures or evidence
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before adding a dependency or changing the accepted UI toolkit, package/public contract, architecture, persistence/security posture or product behavior.
Stop and route to /spec-design if preset configuration requires a new module, graph edge, ownership rule or composition-root business behavior.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-005 if execution exposes a required identity, tier, dependency, acceptance or material-scope change; do not hide it behind repair.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-006 or FT-007 if proving the preset surface requires implementing countdown, recovery, overdue or alert behavior owned by those features.

constraints: Settings & Location owns the validated timer-duration values, automatic persistence and last-valid-value preservation; the task must not create a second Settings owner.
Timer & Alert reads the validated three-duration projection and remains the sole owner of active timer state; configuration does not write timer lifecycle state or calculate countdown time.
Main Display owns preset button composition and gestures; it consumes Settings and Timer projections and does not read private stores or perform timer arithmetic.
Only timer-duration fields are in scope; generalized Settings validation, API-key handling, location, alert-volume and glass personalization remain with their owning features.
Exact persistence primitive, class split and filename identity remain execution discretion inside the accepted code roots unless they change an accepted boundary or require a new dependency.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-001 / REQ-011: exactly three independent preset definitions are available, configuration does not create parallel active timer state, and Timer & Alert remains the active-state owner.
FT-005-AC-002 / REQ-011: each duration field enforces hours 0–99, minutes 0–59 and seconds 0–59, rejects zero total duration, and preserves the last valid persisted value.
FT-005-AC-003 / REQ-011: defaults are 3m, 10m and 30m; labels expose only the highest non-zero unit with floor rounding.

FT-005-AC-004 / REQ-011: buttons expose the accepted orange, pink and purple neon outlines and selected/active presentation data is available through the existing Main Display ↔ Timer & Alert contract.

.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#dependency-graph: the approved Main Display → Settings & Location, Timer & Alert → Settings & Location and Main Display → Timer & Alert edges remain the only crossed boundaries.

.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#deterministic-host-side-checks: isolated persistence, validation, label, color and projection checks produce reproducible results; no planning-time runtime evidence is claimed.
